title: Shared-ref fetch guard still walks the directory, not tracked files
description:
pqs moved TestNoProductionCodeReadsFetchHead onto gittest.Tracked, because a checkout is not a clean room: an agent worktree under .claude/worktrees/ is no party to this tree.

Its sibling in the same file, TestEveryProductionFetchStaysOffSharedRefs, still uses filepath.Walk. It skips only .git, testdata, vendor and node_modules, so a stale branch checked out under the repo can fail the gate on a file nobody here wrote. That is the class pqs exists to close.
evidence: internal/runstate/fetchhead_guard_test.go:90-110

ticfac run epic-t8u filed this backlog tick from the finding 6ed5fa02862a9f0483faffad24d5c64b4a7516e6abb6da13cc495e3a5ed7361e (reported by run-epic-t8u/tick-r6v/attempt-18) rather than absorb it into the running epic: it is not absorbed: only a finding the final reviewer names blocking, or a high-severity one whose reporter names the done item it breaks while the work is under way, enters the running epic. The decision record is .ticfac/runs/epic-t8u/absorptions/6ed5fa02862a9f0483faffad24d5c64b4a7516e6abb6da13cc495e3a5ed7361e.json on the run branch.
